newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FULL TEXT-Schedule of Wallis report implementation.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT-Schedule of Wallis report implementation.

text.p: The following is the proposed timetable for implementation of the recommendations, if accepted, made by the Wallis inquiry into the Australian financial sector.
- announcement of the Government's decisions on mergers policy and ownership of financial institutions;
- development and announcement of the Government's in-principle responses to the proposals for the regulatory framework;
- establishment of the FSAC (Financial Sector Advisory Council);
- implementation of the changes to promote competition in the payments system and to improve disclosure and consumer protection regulation;

- negotiation and agreement with the States and Territories on the in-principle approach to be adopted to the proposed transfer of prudential and related responsibilities to the Commonwealth, the changes to the responsibilities of the ASC (Australian Securities Commission), and the establishment of the PUCL (Panel for Uniform Commercial Laws);

- establishment by legislation of the new regulatory agencies and their investment with existing regulatory functions, with parallel processes of internal consultation within existing regulatory agencies;
- development and enactment of legislative reforms, and the subsequent implementation of reform proposals by the regulatory agencies; and
- implementation of the outcome of proposed review processes, for example for the Uniform Consumer Credit Code."
